Items — classify each DONE / PARTIAL / NOT DONE and say exactly what's missing:

VOLUMES & DISK
1. Portable volumes model: one volume = one filesystem at a data path, detachable/attachable across servers. Files: lib/actions-volumes.ts, worker/volumes.ts, app/dashboard/volumes.
2. SAFE-DETACH: does the system refuse to detach a volume that the server depends on / has data on / has system paths mounted on it? Is it enforced in the action, or only a UI hint?
3. Reinstall can no longer wipe attached volumes (commit 07fdf16) — is the guard actually in the reinstall path?
4. PER-SERVER DISK EXPANSION ("add more storage to this server"): (a) as an upsell in the deploy wizard priced into the term total, (b) as an "Add storage" action after deploy, prorated, using the wallet-then-card split. Check lib/disk-expand.ts, lib/extra-disk.ts, worker/disk-expand.ts, lib/actions-disk.ts. Verify: schema column (extraDiskGB?), the worker actually does qm resize + growpart + resize2fs, RENEWAL BILLING includes the extra disk every month, and the value is preserved across a plan change/resize. Also confirm the one-way (no shrink) guard.
5. The "resize shrink failure" fix in commit 8c8b7d9.
6. Admin setting for per-GB storage price — does the price actually come from the DB setting at both purchase points?

BACKUPS
7. Live backup/restore PROGRESS BARS with real updates (not fake). Trace where progress is written and read.
8. Customer backup RETENTION: keep only the latest 2, auto-delete older. Is pruning actually executed?
9. Customer backups run AUTOMATICALLY once a week (scheduler). Check worker/backup-schedule.ts — is it registered in worker/index.ts and does it run?
10. WHOLE-SYSTEM backup daily, keep latest 3, auto-delete older. Is there any system-level backup job (cron/systemd/script under /opt/nxeon/scripts) and does it prune to 3?
11. Bug: "i tried creating a backup but it just shut down the server" — verify backup no longer stops/errors the server (commit 92302c3), and whether a failed backup shows a clear "Backup failed — server unaffected" notice in the UI.

Report numbered with file:line evidence. Do not write files.

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Nxeon — customer VM backups via vzdump
     3	# Backs up all QEMU guests (running or stopped) with VMID in [100, 9000)
     4	# to Proxmox storage "backup" using zstd compression, snapshot mode, keeping
     5	# the last 3 backups per VM at the storage level. Templates (9000-9999) are
     6	# excluded. Idempotent / re-runnable.
     7	set -euo pipefail
     8	
     9	STORAGE="${NXEON_VM_BACKUP_STORAGE:-backup}"
    10	KEEP_LAST="${NXEON_VM_BACKUP_KEEP:-3}"
    11	
    12	log() { echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)] $*"; }
    13	
    14	# Collect eligible VMIDs: numeric first column of `qm list`, VMID>=100, <9000.
    15	mapfile -t VMIDS < <(qm list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $1>=100 && $1<9000 {print $1}' | sort -n)
    16	
    17	if [ "${#VMIDS[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
    18	    log "no eligible VMs (none with 100 <= VMID < 9000); nothing to back up"
    19	    exit 0
    20	fi
    21	
    22	log "eligible customer VMs: ${VMIDS[*]}"
    23	
    24	# Optional dry-run: NXEON_VM_BACKUP_DRYRUN=1 only prints the selection/command.
    25	if [ "${NXEON_VM_BACKUP_DRYRUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    26	    log "DRY RUN — would run: vzdump ${VMIDS[*]} --storage ${STORAGE} --compress zstd --mode snapshot --prune-backups keep-last=${KEEP_LAST}"
    27	    exit 0
    28	fi
    29	
    30	log "running vzdump -> storage '${STORAGE}' (zstd, snapshot, keep-last=${KEEP_LAST})"
    31	vzdump "${VMIDS[@]}" \
    32	    --storage "$STORAGE" \
    33	    --compress zstd \
    34	    --mode snapshot \
    35	    --prune-backups "keep-last=${KEEP_LAST}"
    36	
    37	log "done"
=====DB=====
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Nxeon — PostgreSQL logical backups
     3	# pg_dumps both databases (nxeon, nxeon_staging) as the postgres user to
     4	# /tank/backup/db/, gzip-compressed with timestamped filenames, and prunes
     5	# dumps older than RETENTION_DAYS. Idempotent / re-runnable.
     6	set -euo pipefail
     7	
     8	BACKUP_DIR="/tank/backup/db"
     9	RETENTION_DAYS="${NXEON_DB_RETENTION_DAYS:-14}"
    10	DATABASES=(nxeon nxeon_staging)
    11	TS="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
    12	
    13	mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
    14	
    15	log() { echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)] $*"; }
    16	
    17	rc=0
    18	for db in "${DATABASES[@]}"; do
    19	    # Skip cleanly if the database does not exist (e.g. staging removed).
    20	    if ! sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${db}'" | grep -q 1; then
    21	        log "database '${db}' not present, skipping"
    22	        continue
    23	    fi
    24	
    25	    dest="${BACKUP_DIR}/${db}-${TS}.sql.gz"
    26	    tmp="${dest}.partial"
    27	    log "dumping '${db}' -> ${dest}"
    28	    if sudo -u postgres pg_dump --no-owner --no-privileges "$db" | gzip -c > "$tmp"; then
    29	        mv "$tmp" "$dest"
    30	        # Integrity check: gzip stream must decompress cleanly.
    31	        if gunzip -t "$dest"; then
    32	            log "OK ${dest} ($(du -h "$dest" | cut -f1))"
    33	        else
    34	            log "ERROR gunzip -t failed for ${dest}"
    35	            rc=1
    36	        fi
    37	    else
    38	        log "ERROR pg_dump failed for '${db}'"
    39	        rm -f "$tmp"
    40	        rc=1
    41	    fi
    42	done
    43	
    44	# Prune dumps older than RETENTION_DAYS.
    45	log "pruning dumps older than ${RETENTION_DAYS} days in ${BACKUP_DIR}"
    46	find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.sql.gz' -mtime "+${RETENTION_DAYS}" -print -delete || true
    47	
    48	log "done (exit ${rc})"
    49	exit "$rc"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Off-box backup replication.
     3	#
     4	# Copies /tank/backup/db (and optionally VM dumps) to an OFFSITE target so a
     5	# chassis/disk loss doesn't take the backups with it. Inert until configured —
     6	# set ONE of the following in /etc/nxeon/backup-offsite.env:
     7	#
     8	#   OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE="b2:nxeon-backups"     # rclone remote (Backblaze B2, S3, OVH Object Storage…)
     9	#   OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET="user@host:/backups/nxeon"   # rsync over SSH (rsync.net etc.)
    10	#   OFFSITE_INCLUDE_VMS=1                        # optional: also replicate VM dumps (large)
    11	#
    12	# Exits non-zero on a real failure so the systemd OnFailure hook alerts admins.
    13	set -uo pipefail
    14	
    15	ENV_FILE="/etc/nxeon/backup-offsite.env"
    16	SRC_DB="/tank/backup/db"
    17	SRC_VMS="/tank/backup/dump"
    18	
    19	log() { echo "[$(date -Is)] $*"; }
    20	
    21	[ -f "${ENV_FILE}" ] && . "${ENV_FILE}"
    22	
    23	OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE="${OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE:-}"
    24	OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET="${OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET:-}"
    25	OFFSITE_INCLUDE_VMS="${OFFSITE_INCLUDE_VMS:-0}"
    26	
    27	if [ -z "${OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE}" ] && [ -z "${OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET}" ]; then
    28	  log "off-site replication NOT CONFIGURED — set OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE or OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET in ${ENV_FILE}"
    29	  log "backups currently live only on this chassis (${SRC_DB}) — a disk/host loss would lose them"
    30	  exit 0   # not an error: intentionally inert until configured
    31	fi
    32	
    33	[ -d "${SRC_DB}" ] || { log "FAIL: ${SRC_DB} missing"; exit 1; }
    34	
    35	sync_one() {
    36	  local src="$1" label="$2" rc=0
    37	  if [ -n "${OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE}" ]; then
    38	    command -v rclone >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "FAIL: rclone not installed (apt install rclone)"; return 1; }
    39	    log "rclone sync ${label}: ${src} -> ${OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE}/${label}"
    40	    rclone sync "${src}" "${OFFSITE_RCLONE_REMOTE}/${label}" --transfers 4 --retries 3 || rc=$?
    41	  else
    42	    command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "FAIL: rsync not installed"; return 1; }
    43	    log "rsync ${label}: ${src} -> ${OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET}/${label}"
    44	    rsync -az --delete -e "ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new" \
    45	      "${src}/" "${OFFSITE_RSYNC_TARGET}/${label}/" || rc=$?
    46	  fi
    47	  [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ] || { log "FAIL: ${label} replication exited ${rc}"; return 1; }
    48	  log "OK ${label} replicated"
    49	}
    50	
    51	fail=0
    52	sync_one "${SRC_DB}" "db" || fail=1
    53	if [ "${OFFSITE_INCLUDE_VMS}" = "1" ] && [ -d "${SRC_VMS}" ]; then
    54	  sync_one "${SRC_VMS}" "vms" || fail=1
    55	fi
    56	
    57	[ "${fail}" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
    58	log "off-site replication complete"

I have full traces for all 11 items. Here are the findings.

---

## VOLUMES & DISK

### 1. Portable volumes model — **PARTIAL**

Wired end-to-end for the *block device* lifecycle, but not for the two claims in the item.

- UI: `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/volumes/page.tsx:10-53` → `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/Volumes.tsx` (list + per-server panel at :259).
- Actions: `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-volumes.ts:55` `orderVolume`, `:114` `attachVolume`, `:147` `detachVolume`, `:167` `deleteVolume`.
- Worker: `/opt/nxeon/worker/volumes.ts:118/136/214/255`, registered in `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:782-785`.
- Provider: real Proxmox config POSTs at `/opt/nxeon/worker/volumes.ts:167`, `:236`, `:273/279`.
- Renewal billing exists: `/opt/nxeon/worker/product-renewals.ts:328` `chargeVolumeRenewal`.

Missing:
- **"one volume = one filesystem at a data path" is NOT implemented.** Nothing formats or mounts. No `mkfs`, no fstab, no mount path in `worker/volumes.ts`; the schema `Volume` model (`/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:650-663`) has no mount-path/fs-type column. The attach notification literally says "Format and mount it inside the server to use it" (`/opt/nxeon/worker/volumes.ts:204`). The only place a volume gets a filesystem at a data path is the *migration* engine (`/opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-real.ts:227` `EXTRA_DISK_MOUNT="/mnt/nxeon-data"`, `:1300` `mkfs.ext4`), and only with explicit Docker consent.
- **"attachable across servers" is NOT true once the volume holds data.** `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-volumes.ts:129-131` hard-rejects attaching to any server other than the one recorded in `volume.serverId`, and `detachVolume` never clears `serverId` (`/opt/nxeon/worker/volumes.ts:240` sets only `status`). The UI mirrors this filter at `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/Volumes.tsx:278-281`. So a volume is pinned to its first server forever.

### 2. SAFE-DETACH — **NOT DONE**

There is no dependency check anywhere in the detach path.

- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-volumes.ts:147-164`: the only guards are `status === "ATTACHED"` and the one-in-flight-job debounce. No check for mounted filesystems, `/etc/fstab` entries, system paths, or Docker data living on the volume.
- `/opt/nxeon/worker/volumes.ts:214-249`: yanks the disk out of the VM config unconditionally (`delete: key` at :236) with no in-guest unmount or in-use probe.
- The only "safe detach" content in the codebase is **advisory text**, not enforcement: `/opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-real.ts:245-248` ("IMPORTANT: this volume is now in use by the server … detaching it will break Docker") and `:3517` ("do not detach it"). Nothing persists that state — there is no `inUse` field on `Volume` — so `detachVolume` cannot and does not consult it.
- UI is a bare `window.confirm` that actively reassures the user: `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/Volumes.tsx:172-173` and `:319-320` — `"Detach … Data is preserved."`. That message is wrong for a volume carrying `/var/lib/docker`.

**Missing:** an in-guest check (mountpoint / fstab / `lsof`) before detach, a persisted "in use by system" flag set when migration moves Docker onto the volume, and an action-level refusal.

### 3. Reinstall guard (07fdf16) — **DONE**

Enforced in both layers, worker first:

- Worker: `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:428-444` — queries `Volume` where `serverId + status:"ATTACHED"`, filters out sandbox-only volids (`:434-436`), throws before any status change or `destroyVm` (`:446-448`). Correctly blocks even volumes whose `diskName` is null.
- Action pre-check: `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:464-471` in `serverAction`.
- Note: `reinstallToOs` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:81`) does **not** carry the action-level pre-check, but it enqueues the same `REINSTALL` job so the worker guard at `:428` still catches it. The customer gets a job failure rather than an inline form error — cosmetic, not a data-safety hole.

### 4. Per-server disk expansion — **DONE** (both purchase points, full chain)

(a) Deploy upsell priced into the term total:
- UI slider `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx:409-472`, hidden field `:212`, term math `:174-176` (`addonTermCents = (ipMonthly + extraDiskMonthly) * termMonths`), review line `:558-570`.
- Server-side quote: `/opt/nxeon/lib/order.ts:121-138` (`extraDiskCents = extraDiskMonthlyCents * term.months`, folded into `chargeCents`), persisted `:252`, own invoice line `:219-230`.
- Worker provisions at effective size — no separate job: `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:308-311`.

(b) Post-deploy "Add storage", prorated, wallet-then-card:
- UI `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/AddStorage.tsx` (mounted at `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx:567-577`), uses the shared `walletSplit` at `:79`.
- Action `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-disk.ts:36-121`: `diskExpandQuote` → `walletSplit` (`:85`) → Stripe checkout for the card remainder (`:96`) or `applyDiskExpand` (`:113`).
- Card path completes: `/opt/nxeon/app/api/stripe/confirm/route.ts:76-94` calls `applyDiskExpand` with `chargeCents`, gated on the idempotent `credited` flag.
- Proration: `/opt/nxeon/lib/disk-expand.ts:122-126`.

Schema column: `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:325` `extraDiskGB Int @default(0)`.

Worker really does the work: `/opt/nxeon/worker/disk-expand.ts:344-347` (`PUT .../resize` with `+<delta>G`), `:243-247` `growpart`, `:256-263` `resize2fs` / `xfs_growfs` / `btrfs resize`. Registered at `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:789`. Deliberately excluded from `VM_STATE_FAILURE_JOBS` (`:46-51`). Failed expansion is refunded by `reconcileFailedDiskExpand` (`/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:814-872`), keyed on `extraDiskGB` actually reaching target (`:833`).

Renewal billing includes it every month — both renewal paths:
- Sweep: `/opt/nxeon/worker/billing.ts:48-50`, `:104-116`, own invoice line `:161-170`.
- Manual "Renew now": `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:605-610`, invoice line `:656-665`.

Preserved across plan change/resize:
- Upgrade worker: `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:559-560, 580-584` sizes to `effectiveDiskGB(newPlan.diskGB, server.extraDiskGB)`.
- Upgrade quote never touches it: `/opt/nxeon/lib/resize.ts:35-53`.
- Downgrade guard compares plan disks: `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:163-167`.

One-way (no shrink) guard: no decrement path exists anywhere (verified by grep — the only writes to `extraDiskGB` are `/opt/nxeon/worker/disk-expand.ts:317` and `:372`, both `Math.max`-clamped at `:296-299`), plus the Proxmox-level `deltaGB > 0` check at `/opt/nxeon/worker/disk-expand.ts:340-341` and the `EXTRA_DISK_ONE_WAY_NOTE` shown before every purchase (`AddStorage.tsx:151`, `DeployWizard.tsx:468` and `:606-611`).

### 5. Resize shrink fix (8c8b7d9) — **DONE, but the commit attribution is wrong**

The fix is live at `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:559-560` and `:580-584`. But `git blame` shows it landed in **29ea0d3**, not 8c8b7d9:

```
29ea0d38 (root 2026-07-25 18:30:22 +0000 559) const newTotalDiskGB = effectiveDiskGB(newPlan.diskGB, server.extraDiskGB);
```

`git show --stat 8c8b7d9` does not contain `worker/index.ts` at all — its only code change is a Stripe-metadata size tweak in `lib/order.ts:80`. The commit message claims a worker change it does not carry. Functionally fine; the claim in the changelog is inaccurate.

### 6. Admin per-GB storage price from DB — **DONE**, at all four points

- Admin UI: `/opt/nxeon/components/admin/settings/BillingPanel.tsx:29-40` (both `volume_price_cents_per_gb` and `extra_disk_gb_price_cents`), saved via `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-settings.ts:52-53`. Defaults `/opt/nxeon/lib/settings.ts:44,49`.
- Single reader: `/opt/nxeon/lib/disk-expand.ts:55-58` `extraDiskPerGbCents()`.
- Purchase point 1 (deploy): `/opt/nxeon/lib/order.ts:122` server-side; wizard display fed from the same function at `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx:73`.
- Purchase point 2 (add storage): `/opt/nxeon/lib/disk-expand.ts:119`; display fed at `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx:91` and passed at `:572`.
- Renewals also read it: `/opt/nxeon/worker/billing.ts:48`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:605`.
- Volumes use the separate setting: `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-volumes.ts:22`, page display `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/volumes/page.tsx:23`.

---

## BACKUPS

### 7. Live progress bars with real updates — **DONE**

Real, not fake, outside sandbox.

- **Written**: `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:693-702` `reportJobProgress` (backup), `/opt/nxeon/worker/restore.ts:7-16` (restore). Values come from `/opt/nxeon/lib/proxmox.ts:191-261` `waitForTaskProgress`, which polls the real Proxmox task log every 2s (`:226`) and parses the vzdump/qmrestore `%` in `/opt/nxeon/lib/proxmox.ts:155-179` `parseTaskProgress`. Monotonic (`:244`); when no `%` has appeared yet it uses a time-based creep capped at 85% of the window (`:240-242`) — honest fallback, not a fake full bar.
- Callers: backup `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:743-748`; restore `/opt/nxeon/worker/restore.ts:121-126` (windowed `base:10, span:80`).
- **Stored**: `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:367-368` (`Job.progress`, `Job.step`).
- **Read**: `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server.ts:107-124` `getBackupJob` (ownership-checked).
- **Rendered**: `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/BackupControls.tsx:65-78` (2.5s poll), bar at `:112-128`; SSR seed at `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx:440-444`.

### 8. Retention keep-latest-2 — **PARTIAL**

Pruning is real and executed: `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:751-758` calls `pruneBackups(conn, server.vmid, CUSTOMER_BACKUP_KEEP)` with `CUSTOMER_BACKUP_KEEP = 2` (`:39`); implementation `/opt/nxeon/lib/proxmox.ts:413-429` sorts by `ctime` desc and deletes the tail via `/opt/nxeon/lib/proxmox.ts:403-405`. Runs after both manual and scheduled backups (same handler).

What's missing / risky:
- Pruning only ever runs **on the success path of a new backup** (`:749` then `:751`). If a backup fails, or if a customer disables auto-backup after accumulating archives, nothing ever prunes. There is no standalone retention sweep.
- **Retention collision with the host-level job.** `pruneBackups` filters only on `vmid` over the whole `backup` storage (`/opt/nxeon/lib/proxmox.ts:414-417`) — the same PVE storage (`/etc/pve/storage.cfg`: `dir: backup → /tank/backup`) that `/opt/nxeon/scripts/backup-vms.sh:31-35` writes to. So a customer clicking "Create backup" deletes the platform's own VM backups for that VMID down to 2. (Currently masked because the prod drop-in also forces 2 — see item 10.)

### 9. Weekly automatic customer backups — **PARTIAL**

The scheduler is real and running:
- `/opt/nxeon/worker/backup-schedule.ts:21-66` — due-check `:46-47`, in-flight guard `:50-53`, enqueue `:55`, anti-pile-up timestamp `:58-61`.
- Imported `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:15` and **actually registered in the loop** at `:1066-1073` (every 15 min). Confirmed it is a live sweep, not dead code.
- Setting action `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:45-72`; UI `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/BackupSchedule.tsx` (weekly = 168h is an option, `:11`); cadences `/opt/nxeon/lib/backup-intervals.ts:7`.

Missing for "runs automatically once a week":
- **Opt-in and OFF by default**: `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:342` `autoBackup Boolean @default(false)`. Nothing ever sets it to true except the customer toggle — grep for `autoBackup` returns exactly 4 sites, only one of which writes (`actions-server-lifecycle.ts:59`).
- **The paid deploy add-on is a no-op.** The wizard sells "Daily backups" (`/opt/nxeon/components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx:209`), it is parsed at `/opt/nxeon/lib/order.ts:68` and stored as `addons.dailyBackup` at `:183`, but the only consumer is a type declaration in `buildCloudInit` (`/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:95`) — it is **never read to set `autoBackup`**. A customer who checks that box gets no scheduled backups at all.
- The UI default cadence is 24h, not weekly (`BackupSchedule.tsx:27`).
- Sweep is disabled in sandbox (`backup-schedule.ts:22`).

### 10. Whole-system daily backup, keep 3 — **PARTIAL / doesn't match spec**

A system-level backup exists and is live, but neither the cadence nor the retention matches.

- Script: `/opt/nxeon/scripts/backup-vms.sh` — `KEEP_LAST` defaults to 3 (`:10`) and prunes via `vzdump --prune-backups keep-last=` (`:35`).
- **But the production drop-in overrides it to 2**: `/etc/systemd/system/nxeon-backup-vms.service.d/retention.conf` → `Environment=NXEON_VM_BACKUP_KEEP=2`. Effective retention is 2, not 3.
- **And it runs weekly, not daily**: `/etc/systemd/system/nxeon-backup-vms.timer` → `OnCalendar=Sun *-*-* 04:30:00`. Docs agree it is weekly by design: `/opt/nxeon/docs/DOCUMENTATION.md:458` and `:544`.
- The daily job is the *database* backup only: `/opt/nxeon/scripts/backup-db.sh` (`OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:15:00`), and its retention is **14 days**, not 3 (`backup-db.sh:9,46`).
- Off-site replication is daily but **inert until configured** — `/opt/nxeon/scripts/backup-offsite.sh:27-31` exits 0 with a "NOT CONFIGURED" log unless `/etc/nxeon/backup-offsite.env` exists.
- All timers are `enabled` and have fired (`systemctl list-timers`), so the jobs do run.
- Nothing backs up the PVE host config itself (`/etc/pve`) — no such script exists.

**Missing:** daily cadence for the VM/system backup, keep-3 retention (currently 2 by drop-in override), and the retention-collision fix noted in item 8.

### 11. "Backup shut down the server" bug (92302c3) — **DONE for backups; the failure notice is misleading for restores**

Backup no longer errors the server:
- `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:49-51` `VM_STATE_FAILURE_JOBS` contains `PROVISION, REINSTALL, DELETE, RESIZE, START, STOP, REBOOT, SUSPEND, UNSUSPEND, BACKUP_RESTORE, SNAPSHOT_ROLLBACK` — `BACKUP_CREATE` is deliberately absent. Enforced at `:975-977`.
- The backup itself never stops the VM: `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:737-742` uses `mode: "snapshot"` (live snapshot), no stop/start call anywhere in the handler.
- UI notice exists and is wired: `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/BackupControls.tsx:130-150` — "**Backup failed — your server is unaffected**", with the real `Job.error` (`:143-145`) and a 15-minute freshness window so it doesn't nag (`:10`, `:84-87`).

The one problem: that same component renders the notice for **restores** too. `verbFor` (`:16-18`) makes it read "*Restore* failed — your server is unaffected", and the body says "No changes were made to your running server" (`:146-148`). That is false for a restore — `BACKUP_RESTORE` **is** in `VM_STATE_FAILURE_JOBS` (`worker/index.ts:50`), so a terminal restore failure flips the server to `ERROR`, and `/opt/nxeon/worker/restore.ts:103-110` has already stopped the VM and overwritten its disk by then. The reassurance is inverted precisely in the case where the customer most needs a warning.

---

## Summary

| # | Item | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Portable volumes model | PARTIAL — no filesystem/mount automation; pinned to first server, not portable |
| 2 | SAFE-DETACH | **NOT DONE** — no check anywhere; UI wrongly says "data is preserved" |
| 3 | Reinstall volume guard | DONE (worker + action) |
| 4 | Per-server disk expansion (a)+(b) | DONE end-to-end incl. renewals, plan-change preservation, one-way guard |
| 5 | Resize shrink fix | DONE — but shipped in 29ea0d3; 8c8b7d9's message misattributes it |
| 6 | Admin per-GB price | DONE at both purchase points + both renewal paths |
| 7 | Live progress bars | DONE — real Proxmox task-log parsing |
| 8 | Keep-latest-2 retention | PARTIAL — only prunes after a successful backup; collides with host-level job |
| 9 | Weekly auto customer backups | PARTIAL — scheduler runs, but off by default and the paid "Daily backups" add-on is a no-op |
| 10 | System backup daily / keep 3 | PARTIAL — weekly, keep 2 (drop-in override); DB daily but 14-day retention |
| 11 | Backup no longer stops server | DONE for backups; failure notice is wrong for restores |

The three I'd act on first, in order: **item 2** (no safe-detach enforcement + actively misleading confirm text), **item 9's dead add-on** (customers pay for "Daily backups" and get nothing), and **item 8/10's shared-storage retention collision** (a customer's manual backup prunes the platform's own host-level VM backups).
